$comment: Every route of the one server, in one place. Edit here, then run: npm run app-map --prefix web
That checks the routes in App.tsx and admin-app/main.tsx against this file, and writes server/app/routes.json,
server/app/mcp/app_map.json and the route tables in README.md and .gaer/agents/instructions.md.
app: app (index.html) | admin (admin.html) | server (FastAPI). access: public | user | admin | token (OAuth bearer).
chrome: own = no top bar (own layout). embeddable: may be framed by the browser extension and Office hosts.

what.en: The web app's home. **Anonymous visitors are redirected to `/w/`** (by the server, and by the SPA on client-side navigation).

**Public website**, server-rendered HTML from Markdown pages (`web_pages`), da/en via `?lang=` + `w_lang` cookie. The front page is the Markdown page with an empty slug, or — setting `web_front = "facit246"` in `/admin/web` — the fixed "Facit · 246" story (da/en/de/sv/no, browser language by default; `web_front.py`, design in `specs/forside-246/`). The front page always ends with a **login card**; on a new instance (no users, no `BOOTSTRAP_ADMIN_EMAIL`) it says the first person to log in becomes admin. A placeholder is shown until a front page is written.
what.da: Offentligt website: Markdown-sider fra `/admin/web` (dansk/engelsk). Forsiden er Markdown-siden eller „Facit · 246“ (valgt i `/admin/web`) og slutter altid med et login-kort; på en ny instans står der, at den første, der logger ind, bliver administrator.

what.en: E-mail → one-time code → second factor if "Kræv passkey" is on, else a passkey offer (see `gaer-auth`). Shows the first-user/admin notice when `first_user` is true. Also `/extension/login` and `/m/login` (same page, embedded layout).
what.da: E-mail → engangskode → anden faktor, hvis „Kræv passkey“ er slået til, ellers tilbud om passkey. Viser, når man bliver den første admin. Også `/extension/login` og `/m/login`.

what.en: Clips, files in Object Storage, account (profile, avatar, passkeys, security keys, authenticator apps, "Kræv passkey", sessions), own AI consumption and budget (`/konto/forbrug`), privacy + consent + GDPR requests.
what.da: Klip, filer, konto (profil, passkeys, sikkerhedsnøgler, godkendelsesapps, „Kræv passkey“, sessioner), eget AI-forbrug og budget, privatliv og GDPR.

who.en: logged in (`/user/<id>`: people the owner gave access)
who.da: logget ind (`/user/<id>`: dem ejeren har givet adgang)

what.en: **Mit område**: your dashboard (counts, recent activity in your area, areas shared with you), settings (the account page) and sharing: give another user access by e-mail as **reader** (sees overview, clips, files, downloads) or **author** (also creates/edits clips and uploads files; never deletes), optionally expiring. They open it at `/user/<id>`; settings, security and sharing stay the owner's. Everything a delegate does is audited with `on_behalf_of`.
what.da: **Mit område**: overblik (tal, seneste aktivitet, områder delt med dig), indstillinger og deling. Giv en anden bruger adgang som **læser** eller **forfatter** (kan oprette og redigere, aldrig slette), evt. med udløb. De åbner det på `/user/<id>`.

what.en: **Mail, calendar and contacts** (spec in `specs/mail/`): one personal mailbox per user in **Stalwart** plus shared mailboxes (reader/sender/manager), calendars (CalDAV/JMAP) and address books (CardDAV) with sharing, all outbound mail relayed by **Lettermint**, mail kept at most **30 days**. `/user/mail` manages your mailbox, aliases, identities, app passwords, calendars, address books and client setup (`/user/<id>/mail` is the same page for your own id, 404 for anyone else); `/admin/mail` is the operator console (domains + DNS check, mailboxes, shared, calendars & contacts, sending, retention, health, audit) and `/admin/mail/users/<id>` one user's mail. Off unless `MAILBOX_BACKEND` is set.
what.da: **Mail, kalender og kontakter**: personlig postkasse i Stalwart, fælles postkasser, kalendere og adressebøger med deling, udgående mail via Lettermint, mail slettes efter højst 30 dage. `/user/mail` til brugeren, `/admin/mail` til drift.

what.en: **MCP consent** (`/forbind`: a client asks for access, `mcp:admin` needs a fresh second factor) and **deep links** (`/go?path=…&focus=…`, also `/admin/go`) that open a page and focus a `data-deeplink` anchor.
what.da: **MCP-samtykke** (`/forbind`: en klient beder om adgang; `mcp:admin` kræver frisk anden faktor) og **deep links** (`/go?path=…&focus=…`, også `/admin/go`), der åbner en side og fokuserer et `data-deeplink`-anker.

what.en: **Prompt catalogue** for the development process: ready-made prompts to paste into Claude (artifacts, new features, endpoints, migrations, tests, review, debugging), filtered by category and search, copied with one click. Linked from the home page. The prompts live in the code (`web/src/develop/prompts.ts`).
what.da: **Promptkatalog** til udviklingsprocessen: færdige prompts til Claude (artifacts, nye features, endpoints, migrationer, tests, review, fejlfinding) med kategori, søgning og kopiér-knap. Linket fra forsiden.

what.en: **Standalone admin app** (own Vite entry `web/admin.html`): statistics, users + impersonation, features and rings, App Stores, auth/audit log, analytics, heatmaps, GDPR, retention, consent, files, website (`/admin/web`), AI (`/admin/ai`), AI consumption and budgets (`/admin/consumption`), extension & Office (`/admin/integrations`), MCP servers (`/admin/mcp`), webhooks (`/admin/webhooks`), jobs and cleanup (`/admin/jobs`), NATS monitoring (`/admin/nats`), mail (`/admin/mail`), data catalog + Udforsk + API sources (`/admin/data`), settings. Every read and change is audited.
what.da: Administration — en selvstændig app (`web/admin.html`). Kræver anden faktor efter tre logins med engangskode. Alt logges.

what.en: **Mobile app (PWA)**: home, AI chat (if enabled), clips, files with camera upload, profile. Bottom tab bar, own manifest + service worker scoped to `/m/`.
what.da: Mobil-app (PWA) med bundmenu, AI, klip, filer og profil.

who.en: logged in, inside the browser extension

what.en: **Side panel** of the Chrome/Edge extension (iframe). Current page + per-domain consent + save as clip, AI chat with the page as context, clips, account. Talks to the panel over `gaer-bridge`.
what.da: Sidepanelet: aktuel side, klip og AI med siden som kontekst.

what.en: **Office router**: loads Office.js, detects the host, embeds the matching tool. Must stay public (Office closes panes that do not initialise).
what.da: Router for Word, Excel, PowerPoint og Outlook → værktøjerne under `/extension/tools/…`.

who.en: logged in, inside the Office shell

what.en: Office tools: insert/save clips and AI chat with the document or mail as context; Office.js calls go to the shell over `gaer-office-host`.
what.da: Office-værktøjer: indsæt/gem klip og AI med dokumentet eller mailen som kontekst.

what.en: JSON API. State-changing calls need the `X-Gaer: 1` header (CSRF). Groups: `auth`, `me`, `files`, `clips`, `bridge-consent`, `ai`, `public`, `consent`, `collect`, `office`, `extension/download`, `admin`.

**MCP servers** (Streamable HTTP): the app as the logged-in user, and admin where every change is a draft. Consent page `/forbind`; deep links `/go` and `/admin/go`; hub in `/admin/mcp`. OAuth: `/.well-known/oauth-*`, `/mcp/authorize`, `/mcp/token`, `/mcp/register`.
what.da: MCP-servere: appen som den indloggede bruger og admin med kladder. OAuth: `/.well-known/oauth-*`, `/mcp/authorize`, `/mcp/token`, `/mcp/register`.

what.en: Database check + version; used by `deploy/deploy.sh` before switching versions.
